sentences.en: There's an important notice on the notice board today.
sentences.zh: 今天布告牌上有重要的通知。

sentences.en: Make sure to check the notice board for updates before your meeting.
sentences.zh: 开会前记得查看一下布告牌是否有更新。

sentences.en: The notice board at the entrance has new rules about recycling.
sentences.zh: 入口处的布告牌上有新的垃圾分类规定。
